Core Services

Three services we place special emphasis on

We are offering excellent service solutions, with a special emphasis on the following three services.

01

Asia → Türkiye Container Shipping

Weekly FCL and LCL loadings from the Far East to every commercial port in Türkiye. Own NVOCC bills of lading, consolidated LCL boxes and DDU / DAP / DDP deliveries including customs clearance, handled in-house.

Origins

ChinaSouth KoreaVietnamThailandIndonesiaJapanMalaysiaSingapore
See lane details
02

Transit via Türkiye — Door to Door

Mersin and Istanbul as transit gateways to the surrounding region. Full transit customs regimes, bonded handling and inland delivery to the consignee’s door — including hard-to-route markets, always within the applicable legal framework.

Destinations

East EuropeUkraineMiddle East & Surrounding CountriesAzerbaijanIraqArab statesCentral Asia
See lane details
03

Container Sales, Depot & Modification

Buying and selling of new and used containers, depot storage, survey and certified repair, modification, and complete teardown and rebuild in our own yard. Units released with condition reports and photographs.

Scope

Sales & purchaseDepot storageSurvey & repairModificationTeardown & rebuild

Our Assurances

What an agent checks before the first booking

The four questions every overseas partner asks us — answered here, in writing, before you send us a single container.

Legal transit in difficult corridors

East Europe, the Middle East and surrounding countries are served under valid transit regimes with complete documentation. If a routing cannot be done lawfully we say so before you book — not after your cargo is on the water.

Customs, port and operational know-how

Our own staff handle transit declarations, port formalities and inland legs at every Turkish customs office. One operations contact from booking to delivery, with no chain of intermediaries.

Open cost breakdown

Every quote is itemised: freight, THC, documentation, customs and inland carriage. No lump sums and no surprises at destination — what we quote is what we invoice.

Liability & Standard Trading Conditions

We are working under global liability, with published trading conditions

We are working under global liability: ConTurk carries freight-forwarder liability insurance (Global Liability) alongside a published set of Standard Trading Conditions. Both govern every booking we accept, and both are available to read before you place the first one.

  • We are working under global liability — cover valid worldwide
  • Standard Trading Conditions applied to every booking
  • Certificate and conditions shared with agents on request

Route Network

Seven Turkish ports, one Asia corridor, transit onward

We load in the Far East, discharge at İzmit, İzmir, Mersin, İskenderun, Antalya, Samsun and Trabzon, and carry transit cargo onward to East Europe, the Middle East and surrounding countries, Azerbaijan, Iraq and the Gulf. Every corridor runs in both directions.

Our Services

End-to-end logistics solutions

From container shipping to customs clearance, all your transport needs under one roof.

01

Container Shipping

Fast, secure and competitive FCL and LCL container shipping worldwide.

02

Air Freight

Global air freight services for your urgent and time-sensitive shipments.

03

Pre / On / Inland Carriage

Pre-carriage, on-carriage and inland haulage as legs of a container move, so the box travels door to door.

04

Transit Transport

Regular door-to-door transit services through Mersin and Istanbul to East Europe, the Middle East and surrounding countries, Azerbaijan, Iraq and the Arab states.

05

Project / Out-of-Gauge Cargo

Project and out-of-gauge cargo including Open Top, Flatrack, Platform and dry cargo.

06

Reefer Shipping

Temperature-controlled reefer container shipping for cold-chain cargo.

How It Works

With you from quote to delivery

Your cargo travels from your door to its destination through a transparent five-step process.

01

Quote

Share your needs and we will prepare a competitive, clear transport quote.

02

Booking

Once you approve, we create your space and equipment booking.

03

Loading

We safely prepare your cargo and load it onto the right equipment.

04

Transport & Tracking

Your cargo is on the way; track its status in real time with your B/L or container number.

05

Delivery

We deliver your cargo door to door, on time and in full.
